Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.gen

Class TrapPlacer

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.gen.TrapPlacer
public class TrapPlacer extends Object
Hides traps on a generated floor: on plain floor tiles in corridors and ordinary rooms, never in the entrance room or within SAFE_RADIUS tiles of the arrival point, and never on stairs. Trapdoors never appear on boss floors or the floor above the Sanctum.
